The Specification covers manufacture, testing, supply & delivery of new insulati ng oil suitable for use as insulating & heat transfer medium and arc quenching medium in different Transformers and other equipment used in Damodar Valley Corporation. The oil required for filling of the transformers shall conform to IEC 60296 spec (for Uninhibited oil, Type-I) and shall be sent in drums suitable to wi thstand the rigorous transit hazards without any leakage, which will become the property of the purchaser. The transformer oil should be delivered in sealed (ta mper-proof), non-returnable, epoxy coated from inside, perfectly clean steel ba rrels of 209-210 Liters nominal capacity. The characteristic of oil shall be as per specific requirement specified in the late r part of the specification and transformer oil manufacturer shall offer inspectio n of transformer oil during final acceptance test of Transformer oil for issuance of necessary dispatch instruction by the Purchaser. 1.2 SERVICE CONDITION: The transformer oil will be used mainly in PHPS, Panchet, DVC for Generating tr ansformers which remain exposed to all sorts of seasonal weather variations of the tropical & humid climate and rain, thunder, storms along with impact of dust particles on the transformers. The transformer oil should maintain the desi red characteristics despite the operation under severe service conditions of all t ypes of transformers manufactured in India including those fitted with on-load t ap changing equipment. The temperature of the oil may rise up to 110 deg C un der extreme conditions. 1.3 CHARACTERISTICS: The characteristics of the oil when it is sampled at the manufacturer’s works an d / or at the point of delivery and tested in accordance with IS: 335:2018 with la test amendments should comply with the results given in the IS /IEC specificatio n (read along with latest amendments). 2.1 SAMPLING AND TESTING during PDI: Sampling of the oil shall be done in accordance with IS: 6855 (latest revision) an d the tests shall be carried out in accordance with the test methods mentioned I S 335:2018 with latest amendments in the manufacturer's laboratory with all n ecessary arrangements made by the manufacturer. The manufacturers shall ha ve testing facilities in their laboratories as per requirement of the relevant IS/IE C Standards. Any test, which cannot be carried out in their laboratory, should b e carried out from CPRI/ERDA/NABL accredited laboratory. For conducting the tests, the samples may have to be collected in presence of t he representative of the Purchaser at their discretion. Inspection call with prior notice (at least 21 days before-hand) to be given to the Purchaser for deputing of Purchaser’s representatives for carrying out of inspection. The manufacturer will extend all support, assist and arrange for facilities towards carrying out suc cessful inspection.

2.2 PACKING: The tenderer should supply transformer oil in I.S.I. Marked, Sealed, non-returnable, ep oxy coated (resistant to insulating oil) from inside, perfectly clean new steel drums of 209/210 litres nomin al capacity. The outside surface of the drum should be coated with suitable primer and finishing anti-corro sive paint. The drum should conform to IS: 1783 (latest version). 2.3 MARKING: Each drum shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the following: (a) Manufacturer’s name or Trademark, (b) Name of the material, (c) Quantity in litters, (d) The Word “Type-I, Uninhibited”. (e)Date and lot of manufacture, (f) ISI Certification mark as IS :335 (2018 with latest amendments) (g)Name of Consignee as” DVC, PHPS” (h) Each Drum shall be marked with Drum No. 3.1 TEST REPORTS to be supplied during bid submission: The bidder/manufacturer shall submit complete test reports of EHV grade Uninh ibited Type-I transformer oil conforms to IS 335:2018 with latest amendments, carried out in Central Power Research Institute / ERDA/NABL accredited laborato ry at the time of bid submission. Sampling of the oil should be done in accordan ce with IS: 6855 (latest revision). 3.2 TEST REPORTS to be supplied before issuing despatch instruction: The bidder/manufacturer shall submit complete test reports of EHV grade Uninh ibited Type-I transformer oil conforms to IS 335:2018 with latest amendments, carried out in Central Power Research Institute / ERDA/NABL accredited laborato ry at the time of supply. Sampling of the oil shall be done in accordance with IS: 6855 (latest revision). Oxidation stability test shall only be done from any unit of CPRI / ERDA labora tory, and all the cost shall be borne by the bidder/manufacturer. Sampling for th e Oxidation stability test shall be done in presence of DVC representative durin g PDI.

3.3 Acceptance Purchaser reserves the right to carry out inhouse testing of the supplied materi als at destination stores, in presence of authorized representative of the Manufa cturer. In case they are not present, DVC shall Test unilaterally, and their result will be binding on them.
